convert-pdf-to-docx-layout.title: Convert PDF to DOCX with Standard Layout Preservation
convert-pdf-to-docx-layout.description: Shows how to load a PDF and save it as a DOCX file using Aspose.Pdf with the standard content recognition mode to retain the original layout.

convert-pdf-to-docx-enhanced-flow.title: Convert PDF to DOCX with Enhanced Table and Graphic Recognition
convert-pdf-to-docx-enhanced-flow.description: Demonstrates how to convert a PDF file to a DOCX document using Aspose.Pdf with enhanced recognition for complex tables and graphics.

convert-pdf-to-doc-default.title: Convert PDF to DOC with Aspose.Pdf
convert-pdf-to-doc-default.description: Shows how to load a PDF file and save it as a DOC document using Aspose.Pdf's default text extraction settings.

convert-pdf-to-doc-image-extraction.title: Convert PDF to DOCX with Images Only
convert-pdf-to-doc-image-extraction.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF file to a DOCX document using Aspose.Pdf while configuring save options to extract only images.

convert-pdf-to-docx-auto-detection.title: Convert PDF to DOCX with Automatic Content Detection
convert-pdf-to-docx-auto-detection.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF file and save it as a DOCX document using Aspose.Pdf with automatic content detection (DocSaveOptions.Mode set to Auto by default).

convert-pdf-to-doc-plain-text.title: Convert PDF to Plain-Text DOC using DocSaveOptions
convert-pdf-to-doc-plain-text.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and save it as a plain‑text .doc file by configuring DocSaveOptions.

convert-pdf-to-docx-with-metadata.title: Convert PDF to DOCX with Custom Metadata
convert-pdf-to-docx-with-metadata.description: Shows how to convert a PDF file to DOCX using Aspose.Pdf while setting custom metadata properties such as author and title.

convert-pdf-to-docx-with-footnotes.title: Convert PDF to DOCX Preserving Footnotes
convert-pdf-to-docx-with-footnotes.description: Loads a PDF, sets DocSaveOptions to Flow recognition mode, and saves it as a DOCX while keeping footnotes intact.

convert-pdf-to-docx-extract-images.title: Convert PDF to DOCX and Extract Embedded Images
convert-pdf-to-docx-extract-images.description: Loads a PDF, saves it as a DOCX file using Aspose.Pdf, then iterates through each page to extract all embedded images and saves them as PNG files in a designated folder.

convert-pdf-to-docx-with-stats.title: Convert PDF to DOCX and Generate Conversion Report
convert-pdf-to-docx-with-stats.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF file to DOCX using Aspose.Pdf and creating a JSON report with conversion statistics such as file sizes, page count, and elapsed time.

convert-pdf-to-docx-and-zip.title: Convert PDF to DOCX and Zip the Result
convert-pdf-to-docx-and-zip.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, save it as a DOCX file, and then compress the DOCX into a ZIP archive for storage.

convert-pdf-to-docx-and-pdfa.title: Convert PDF to DOCX and then to PDF/A
convert-pdf-to-docx-and-pdfa.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, saving it as a DOCX file using DocSaveOptions, and then converting the DOCX to a PDF/A‑1b compliant PDF with a conversion log.

convert-pdf-to-docx-with-hyphenation.title: Convert PDF to DOCX using Aspose.Pdf
convert-pdf-to-docx-with-hyphenation.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, configuring DocSaveOptions, and saving it as a DOCX file. Highlights that hyphenation settings must be applied after conversion.

convert-pdf-to-docx-add-table-of-figures.title: Convert PDF to DOCX and Add Table of Figures
convert-pdf-to-docx-add-table-of-figures.description: Loads a PDF, extracts all images, creates a Table of Figures on a new first page, and converts the modified PDF to a DOCX file using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-pdf-to-docx-with-embedded-fonts.title: Convert PDF to DOCX with Embedded Custom Fonts
convert-pdf-to-docx-with-embedded-fonts.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF to DOCX using Aspose.Pdf while registering a custom TrueType/OpenType font so the generated DOCX embeds the font for consistent rendering.

convert-pdf-to-pptx.title: Convert PDF to PPTX with Aspose.Pdf
convert-pdf-to-pptx.description: Shows how to convert a PDF file to a PPTX presentation using Aspose.Pdf's Document class and the Save method with SaveFormat.Pptx.

convert-pdf-to-pptx-slides-as-images.title: Convert PDF to PPTX with Slides as Images
convert-pdf-to-pptx-slides-as-images.description: Shows how to convert a PDF document to a PPTX presentation where each slide is rendered as a raster image by using Aspose.Pdf's PptxSaveOptions.

batch-convert-pdfs-to-pptx-slides-as-ima.title: Batch Convert PDFs to PPTX with SlidesAsImages
batch-convert-pdfs-to-pptx-slides-as-ima.description: Shows how to iterate over PDF files in a directory and convert each to a PPTX presentation, rasterizing every slide as an image using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-pdf-to-pptx-slidesasimages-high-.title: Convert PDF to PPTX with SlidesAsImages and High DPI
convert-pdf-to-pptx-slidesasimages-high-.description: Demonstrates how to convert a PDF document to a PPTX presentation using Aspose.Pdf, rendering each slide as an image and setting a high image resolution (DPI) for better quality.

convert-pdf-to-pptx-and-compress.title: Convert PDF to PPTX and Optimize Compression
convert-pdf-to-pptx-and-compress.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF document to a PPTX presentation using Aspose.Pdf and then recompressing the resulting PPTX (a ZIP package) with optimal compression for smaller distribution size.

convert-pdf-to-pptx-and-pdfa.title: Convert PDF to PPTX and then to PDF/A
convert-pdf-to-pptx-and-pdfa.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, saving it as a PPTX file, and then converting the PPTX to a PDF/A-1B document for archival purposes using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-pdf-to-pptx-with-annotation-note.title: Convert PDF to PPTX and Extract Annotation Notes
convert-pdf-to-pptx-with-annotation-note.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF file to a PPTX presentation using Aspose.Pdf and extracting annotation contents from each PDF page for potential speaker notes.

convert-pdf-to-pptx-add-custom-propertie.title: Convert PDF to PPTX and Add Custom Document Properties
convert-pdf-to-pptx-add-custom-propertie.description: The example loads a PDF, sets both standard and custom document properties, and then converts the PDF to a PPTX file using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-pdf-to-pptx-extract-images.title: Convert PDF to PPTX with Aspose.Pdf
convert-pdf-to-pptx-extract-images.description: Shows how to convert a PDF document to a PowerPoint PPTX file using Aspose.Pdf's Document class and the Save method with SaveFormat.Pptx.

pdf-to-pptx-export-slide-titles-csv.title: Convert PDF to PPTX and Export Slide Titles to CSV
pdf-to-pptx-export-slide-titles-csv.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF document to a PPTX file using Aspose.Pdf and then parsing the PPTX package to extract each slide's title into a CSV file for quick reference.

convert-pdf-to-pptx-with-logo.title: Convert PDF to PPTX and Insert Logo on Each Slide
convert-pdf-to-pptx-with-logo.description: The example loads a PDF, stamps a company logo onto every page, converts the modified PDF to a PPTX file, and saves the final presentation. It demonstrates PDF manipulation and conversion using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-pdf-to-single-page-html.title: Convert PDF to Single-Page HTML with Embedded Resources
convert-pdf-to-single-page-html.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF file to a single-page HTML document while embedding CSS, fonts, and images to preserve the original formatting.

convert-pdf-to-multi-page-html.title: Convert PDF to Multi-Page HTML
convert-pdf-to-multi-page-html.description: Loads a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, configures HtmlSaveOptions to split the output into separate pages, and saves the result as HTML.

convert-pdf-to-html-with-svg-images.title: Convert PDF to HTML with External SVG Images
convert-pdf-to-html-with-svg-images.description: Demonstrates how to convert a PDF file to an HTML document using Aspose.Pdf, configure the conversion to generate external SVG/PNG images, and move those image files to a user‑specified folder.

convert-pdf-to-html-with-svg-compression.title: Convert PDF to HTML with Embedded Resources
convert-pdf-to-html-with-svg-compression.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF document and saving it as a single HTML file with all resources (CSS, images, SVG) embedded using HtmlSaveOptions. Includes handling for Windows‑only GDI+ requirements.

convert-pdf-to-html-png-background.title: Convert PDF to HTML with PNG Backgrounds
convert-pdf-to-html-png-background.description: Loads a PDF file and converts it to an HTML document, configuring the conversion to render page backgrounds as PNG images embedded in SVG and embedding all resources directly into the HTML.

convert-pdf-pages-to-separate-html-files.title: Convert PDF Pages to Separate HTML Files
convert-pdf-pages-to-separate-html-files.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, configure HtmlSaveOptions to split the document into pages, and save each page as an individual HTML file.

pdf-to-html-with-toc.title: Convert PDF to HTML with Table of Contents
pdf-to-html-with-toc.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, converting each page to separate HTML files, and generating a simple HTML table of contents linking to those pages.

pdf-to-html-per-page-image-folders.title: Convert PDF to HTML with Separate Image Folders per Page
pdf-to-html-per-page-image-folders.description: This example loads a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, configures HtmlSaveOptions to split the output into separate HTML files per page and store each page's images as external PNG files in dedicated folders, then saves the result.

convert-pdf-to-html-compressed-svg.title: Convert PDF to HTML with Embedded Resources
convert-pdf-to-html-compressed-svg.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, configuring HTML conversion options to embed all resources and embed raster images into SVG, and saving the result as a single HTML file.

pdf-to-html-merge-and-convert-back.title: Convert PDF to HTML pages, merge them, and reconvert to PDF
pdf-to-html-merge-and-convert-back.description: Demonstrates splitting a PDF into separate HTML files with Aspose.Pdf, combining those HTML pages into a single document, and converting the combined HTML back into a PDF.

convert-pdf-to-html-zip.title: Convert PDF to HTML and Package into ZIP Archive
convert-pdf-to-html-zip.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF into separate HTML pages with assets using Aspose.Pdf and then zipping the generated files for distribution.

convert-pdf-to-html-and-minify.title: Convert PDF to HTML and Minify Output
convert-pdf-to-html-and-minify.description: Shows how to convert a PDF file to a single HTML document with embedded resources using Aspose.Pdf, then applies a simple whitespace minification to the generated HTML.

convert-pdf-to-html-with-embedded-custom.title: Convert PDF to HTML and Embed Custom Fonts
convert-pdf-to-html-with-embedded-custom.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF document to a single HTML file with Aspose.Pdf and then injecting @font-face CSS rules to reference custom TrueType fonts.

pdf-to-responsive-html.title: Convert PDF to HTML with Responsive CSS
pdf-to-responsive-html.description: Shows how to convert a PDF document to a single HTML file using Aspose.Pdf, embed raster images, and inject a responsive stylesheet for mobile‑friendly layout.

convert-pdf-to-html-with-custom-css.title: Convert PDF to HTML with Custom CSS
convert-pdf-to-html-with-custom-css.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF document to a single HTML file using Aspose.Pdf and then injecting a link to an external CSS stylesheet to style the generated HTML.

convert-pdf-to-html-sitemap.title: Convert PDF to HTML and Create Sitemap
convert-pdf-to-html-sitemap.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF into separate HTML pages using Aspose.Pdf and then generating a sitemap.xml that lists the created HTML files for SEO purposes.

convert-pdf-to-html-pages-with-index.title: Convert PDF to Separate HTML Pages with Index
convert-pdf-to-html-pages-with-index.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF into individual HTML files per page using Aspose.Pdf and generating an index.html that links to each page.

convert-pdf-to-html-docx-with-embedded-f.title: Convert PDF to HTML and DOCX with Embedded Custom Fonts
convert-pdf-to-html-docx-with-embedded-f.description: The example loads a PDF, registers custom TrueType/OpenType fonts for substitution, converts the PDF to an HTML file with embedded resources, and then saves the PDF as a DOCX with the custom fonts embedded to preserve rendering.

convert-pdf-to-html-and-pptx-with-embedd.title: Convert PDF to HTML and PPTX with Embedded Fonts
convert-pdf-to-html-and-pptx-with-embedd.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF to HTML with all resources embedded and then converting the same PDF directly to a PPTX presentation, allowing Aspose.Pdf to embed the required fonts for consistent appearance.

convert-pdf-to-bmp-images.title: Convert PDF to BMP Images
convert-pdf-to-bmp-images.description: Shows how to load a PDF document and convert each page to a BMP image using Aspose.Pdf's BmpDevice with default settings.

convert-pdf-to-jpeg.title: Convert PDF Pages to JPEG Images
convert-pdf-to-jpeg.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, and save each page as a JPEG image using JpegDevice with default quality settings.

convert-pdf-to-gif-images.title: Convert PDF Pages to GIF Images
convert-pdf-to-gif-images.description: Demonstrates how to convert each page of a PDF document into separate GIF files using Aspose.Pdf's GifDevice with default parameters.

convert-pdf-to-png-transparent-backgroun.title: Convert PDF Pages to PNG with Transparent Background
convert-pdf-to-png-transparent-backgroun.description: Shows how to convert each page of a PDF document to a PNG image while preserving transparency by enabling the TransparentBackground option on PngDevice.

convert-pdf-to-emf-images.title: Convert PDF to EMF Images Preserving Vector Data
convert-pdf-to-emf-images.description: Loads a PDF document and converts each page to an EMF file using Aspose.Pdf's EmfDevice, keeping the original vector graphics intact.

convert-pdf-to-multi-page-tiff.title: Convert PDF to Multi‑Page TIFF
convert-pdf-to-multi-page-tiff.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and use TiffDevice to convert all pages into a single multi‑page TIFF using the default settings.

convert-pdf-to-svg.title: Convert PDF to SVG with Embedded CSS Styles
convert-pdf-to-svg.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF file to SVG using Aspose.Pdf's Document and SvgSaveOptions, enabling CSS style embedding via the ScaleToPixels option.

extract-pdf-page-region-to-png.title: Convert PDF Page Region to PNG
extract-pdf-page-region-to-png.description: Shows how to define a rectangular region on a PDF page, adjust the CropBox, and render that region as a PNG image using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-pdf-page-to-jpeg.title: Convert PDF Page to JPEG with Default DPI
convert-pdf-page-to-jpeg.description: Loads a PDF document, validates a specific page, and uses Aspose.Pdf's JpegDevice to render that page as a JPEG image using the default DPI settings.

batch-convert-pdfs-to-png.title: Batch Convert PDFs to PNG Preserving Folder Structure
batch-convert-pdfs-to-png.description: Demonstrates how to recursively locate PDF files, preserve their original directory hierarchy, and convert each page to a PNG image using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-convert-pdfs-to-jpeg-custom-naming.title: Batch Convert PDFs to JPEG Images with Custom Naming
batch-convert-pdfs-to-jpeg-custom-naming.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through a folder of PDF files, convert each page to a JPEG image using Aspose.Pdf, and save the images with a custom <pdfname>_page<number>.jpg naming pattern.

batch-convert-pdfs-to-multi-page-tiff.title: Batch Convert PDFs to Multi‑Page TIFF
batch-convert-pdfs-to-multi-page-tiff.description: Demonstrates how to convert all PDF files in a folder to multi‑page TIFF archives using Aspose.Pdf, reusing a single TiffDevice instance for efficiency.

validate-and-convert-pdf-to-pdfa-1b.title: Validate and Convert PDF to PDF/A-1b
validate-and-convert-pdf-to-pdfa-1b.description: Loads a PDF, validates it against the PDF/A‑1b standard, logs the validation result, converts the document to PDF/A‑1b, logs the conversion, and saves the compliant file.

convert-pdf-to-pdfa3b-with-font-substitu.title: Convert PDF to PDF/A‑3b with Font Substitution
convert-pdf-to-pdfa3b-with-font-substitu.description: The example loads a PDF, registers a fallback font for any missing fonts, converts the document to PDF/A‑3b format while handling conversion errors, and saves the resulting file.

convert-pdf-to-pdfa4-with-auto-tagging.title: Convert PDF to PDF/A-4 with Auto-Tagging
convert-pdf-to-pdfa4-with-auto-tagging.description: Shows how to enable auto‑tagging and convert a PDF document to PDF/A‑4 format, handling conversion errors and saving the result using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-pdf-to-pdfa-1b-skip-errors.title: Convert PDF to PDF/A-1b Skipping Non‑Convertible Elements
convert-pdf-to-pdfa-1b-skip-errors.description: Loads a PDF, converts it to PDF/A‑1b format while skipping elements that cannot be converted, and saves the output. Demonstrates using ConvertErrorAction.Skip (with fallback to Delete) for version compatibility.

convert-pdf-to-pdfa-3b-throw-errors.title: Convert PDF to PDF/A-3b with Throw on Conversion Errors
convert-pdf-to-pdfa-3b-throw-errors.description: Loads a PDF, converts it to PDF/A‑3b using ConvertErrorAction.Throw to raise exceptions on conversion issues, and saves the resulting file.

convert-pdf-to-pdfa4-with-converterrorac.title: Convert PDF to PDF/A-4 with ConvertErrorAction
convert-pdf-to-pdfa4-with-converterrorac.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF document to PDF/A‑4 using Aspose.Pdf while setting ConvertErrorAction to Convert to attempt conversion of problematic elements, with a fallback for older library versions.

add-external-text-file-attachment-to-pdf.title: Embed Text File and Convert PDF to PDF/A‑3b
add-external-text-file-attachment-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to embed an external text file into a PDF, set the PDF/A‑3 relationship, convert the document to PDF/A‑3b compliance, and save the result.

add-external-xml-attachment-to-pdfa.title: Add XML Attachment to PDF/A-1b Document
add-external-xml-attachment-to-pdfa.description: Demonstrates converting a regular PDF to PDF/A‑1b format and embedding an external XML file as an attachment in the resulting PDF/A‑1b document.

replace-missing-fonts-pdfa-conversion.title: Replace Missing Fonts During PDF/A Conversion
replace-missing-fonts-pdfa-conversion.description: Demonstrates how to map missing fonts to fallback fonts using FontRepository and then convert a PDF to PDF/A with those substitutions applied.

enable-auto-tagging-pdfa-conversion.title: Enable Auto‑Tagging for PDF/A Conversion
enable-auto-tagging-pdfa-conversion.description: Demonstrates how to enable Aspose.Pdf auto‑tagging globally and convert a PDF to PDF/A‑1B using conversion options.

convert-epub-to-pdf-custom-page-size.title: Convert EPUB to PDF with Custom Page Size
convert-epub-to-pdf-custom-page-size.description: Demonstrates loading an EPUB file using EpubLoadOptions and converting it to a PDF while applying a custom page size.

convert-markdown-to-pdf-preserving-code-.title: Convert Markdown to PDF Preserving Code Blocks
convert-markdown-to-pdf-preserving-code-.description: Demonstrates loading a Markdown file with Aspose.Pdf's MdLoadOptions and saving it as a PDF while keeping code block formatting intact.

convert-pcl-to-pdf-hpgl2.title: Convert PCL with HP‑GL/2 Vectors to PDF
convert-pcl-to-pdf-hpgl2.description: Loads a PCL file (including HP‑GL/2 vector data) using Aspose.Pdf and saves it as a PDF document.

convert-postscript-to-pdf.title: Convert PostScript to PDF using Aspose.Pdf
convert-postscript-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PostScript file with Aspose.Pdf and saving it as a PDF using default settings.

xml-to-pdf-xsl-fo-conversion.title: Convert XML (XSL‑FO) to PDF
xml-to-pdf-xsl-fo-conversion.description: Shows how to load an XML file containing XSL‑FO markup with XslFoLoadOptions and save it as a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-xslfo-to-pdf.title: Load PDF and Save with Default Options
convert-xslfo-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF document using Aspose.Pdf and save it unchanged using the default save settings.

convert-latex-to-pdf.title: Convert LaTeX to PDF with Aspose.Pdf
convert-latex-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load a .tex file using TeXLoadOptions and directly save it as a PDF, preserving equations and formatting.

convert-ofd-to-pdf.title: Convert OFD File to PDF
convert-ofd-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading an OFD document with Aspose.Pdf using default load options and saving it as a PDF with default settings, including basic file existence checking and error handling.

convert-pdf-to-epub.title: Convert PDF to EPUB
convert-pdf-to-epub.description: Shows how to load a PDF document with Aspose.Pdf and save it as an EPUB using the default conversion settings.

convert-pdf-to-epub-with-cover.title: Convert PDF to EPUB with Cover Image and Metadata
convert-pdf-to-epub-with-cover.description: Shows how to convert a PDF file to EPUB using Aspose.Pdf, add a cover image as the first page, and set document metadata for the output EPUB.

convert-pdf-to-latex.title: Convert PDF to LaTeX using Aspose.Pdf
convert-pdf-to-latex.description: The example loads a PDF file, configures TeXSaveOptions, and saves the document as a LaTeX (.tex) file while ensuring the output directory exists and providing detailed crash reporting on errors.

convert-pdf-to-latex-with-custom-macros.title: Convert PDF Text to LaTeX with Custom Macros
convert-pdf-to-latex-with-custom-macros.description: Demonstrates extracting plain text from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and generating a LaTeX document with escaped characters and custom macro definitions for special symbols.

convert-pdf-to-text.title: Convert PDF Document to Text File
convert-pdf-to-text.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extract plain text from each page using TextDevice, and save the result to a .txt file.

extract-pdf-text-to-utf8-preserve-line-b.title: Extract PDF Text to UTF-8 File with Line Breaks
extract-pdf-text-to-utf8-preserve-line-b.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extracting its text while preserving line breaks, and saving the result to a UTF‑8 encoded text file.

extract-visible-text-from-pdf.title: Extract Visible Text from PDF to Plain Text
extract-visible-text-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, use TextAbsorber with pure formatting to extract only visible (non‑hidden) text, and write the result to a .txt file.

convert-pdf-to-xps.title: Convert PDF to XPS using XpsSaveOptions
convert-pdf-to-xps.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and saving it as an XPS document using XpsSaveOptions with default settings.

convert-pdf-to-xps-custom-page-size.title: Convert PDF to XPS with Custom Page Size and Landscape Orientation
convert-pdf-to-xps-custom-page-size.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, set each page to a landscape 8.5×11‑inch size, and save the document as an XPS file using XpsSaveOptions.

convert-pdf-to-markdown-default-options.title: Convert PDF to Markdown
convert-pdf-to-markdown-default-options.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF file with Aspose.Pdf and saving it as a Markdown document using MarkdownSaveOptions with default settings.

pdf-to-markdown-with-heading-mapping.title: Convert PDF to Markdown with Heading Level Mapping
pdf-to-markdown-with-heading-mapping.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, reading its tagged structure, and exporting the content to Markdown while mapping PDF heading levels to Markdown heading syntax. Falls back to plain text extraction when tagging is unavailable.

convert-pdf-to-mobixml.title: Convert PDF to MobiXml
convert-pdf-to-mobixml.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF file with Aspose.Pdf and save it as a MobiXml document using the default MobiXmlSaveOptions.

convert-pdf-to-mobixml-with-metadata.title: Convert PDF to MobiXml with Custom Metadata
convert-pdf-to-mobixml-with-metadata.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, setting both standard and custom document metadata, and saving the file as a MobiXml document using MobiXmlSaveOptions.

pdf-to-png-bradley-contrast.title: Convert PDF Pages to PNG with Bradley Contrast Enhancement
pdf-to-png-bradley-contrast.description: The example loads a PDF, renders each page to a PNG image using Aspose.Pdf, applies the Bradley binarization algorithm to improve local contrast, and saves the enhanced PNG files.

create-multi-page-tiff-from-pdf.title: Create Multi‑Page TIFF from PDF
create-multi-page-tiff-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to convert all pages of a PDF document into a multi‑page TIFF file using Aspose.Pdf's TiffDevice with the default LZW compression.

convert-pdf-to-svg-custom-output.title: Convert PDF to SVG with Custom Output Folder
convert-pdf-to-svg-custom-output.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, configuring SvgSaveOptions, and saving it as an SVG file to a specified output directory.
